package.name: ego_planner_2d
package.description: 2D Ego-Planner local planner for ROS1 (melodic / noetic). Ported from JackJu-HIT/Ego-Planner-2D-ROS2, based on the ZJU-FAST-Lab ego-planner. The planner optimizes a 2D (x, y) B-spline trajectory around obstacles, suitable as a local planner for ground robots and fixed-altitude UAVs.
